div.div:
To create This table you have to
iterate through all Paxes, and check for all related Bundles, Baggage, Seat, Meal
Meal takes records in DB according to the number of legs it comes
Meal is per leg per pax
Seat takes records in DB according to the number of legs it comes
Seat is per leg per pax
Each seat or meal per leg is differntiated based on legOrder attribute
